_doctrine: 13-phase Wall Street cycle. Phase is JORDAN'S call (editorial). Until he calls it, phase='Awaiting Jordan's call' and phase_source='awaiting'. Score + trend are facts and always present; phase_suggestion is the auto/brain advisory. next_move is the FORWARD prediction (brain consensus) — where the phase goes next; current phase stays the anchor.

next_move.reasoning: Bullish and bearish breakers cancel and 7-day base rate is a coil, so the honest call is hold inside Complacency until momentum or F&G breaks the range.
next_move.brains_agree: No — analyst explicitly HOLD/Complacency coil; narrative only describes commodity strength with no phase or direction call
next_move.confirmed_if: F&G holds 47-58 and 30d momentum stays ~45-70 with funding near flat and no close through the recent range
next_move.invalidated_if: Momentum breaks above ~75 with F&G above 65 (up into Disbelief) or BTC gives back the recent gain with funding negative while skew stays pinned (down into Anxiety)
